title: Lesson 2 Quiz: Trends, Support, and Resistance

questions.text: How do you recognise an uptrend?
options: A series of higher highs and higher lows
A series of lower highs and lower lows
Price moving within a range with roughly equal highs and lows
Price consistently making lower highs but higher lows
questions.explanation: An uptrend is defined as a series of higher highs and higher lows, like climbing a staircase.

questions.text: True or false: Support is a ceiling where selling interest halts a rise.
questions.explanation: Support is a price level where buying interest tends to stop a fall, acting like a floor. Resistance is the ceiling where selling interest halts a rise.
